a16z-addi:ashbyhq:4dad3bc0-51ea-4df1-bfb.title: Product Marketing Manager
a16z-addi:ashbyhq:4dad3bc0-51ea-4df1-bfb.description: ABOUT ADDI We are a leading financial platform, building the future of payments, shopping, and banking—a world where consumers and merchants can transact effortlessly and grow together. As the country’s leading Buy Now, Pay Later provider, we have secured regulatory approval to operate as a bank, unlocking even greater opportunities for our customers. Our mission has earned the trust of world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Architect Capital, GIC, Goldman Sachs, Greycroft, Monashees, Notable Capital, Quona Capital, Union Square Ventures, Victory Park Capital, and more, who back our vision for the future. If you’re ready to be part of something big, keep reading. WHAT’S THE MISSION YOU’LL DRIVE Own the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Addi’s consumer lending products, translating product features into compelling customer narratives that drive adoption, engagement, and market leadership while serving as the crucial bridge between Product, Marketing, and Sales to ensure seamless product launches and sustained growth in Colombian market. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Product taxonomy, naming, and positioning frameworks defined. Build the canonical taxonomy for Addi's consumer product portfolio (consumer credit lines like Cupo / Intro / Grande; CF; Marketplace programs). Establish naming standards, category hierarchy, and positioning frameworks per product. This is the source of truth every Growth Manager, BU lead, and customer-facing stakeholder references. - Cross-BU launch playbook codified and adopted. A single playbook used for every launch (credit policies, programs, product features, CF expansion). The Bank Growth Manager owns launch sequencing and the launch outcome; PMM partners on the narrative and post-launch retention messaging. - Web messaging and positioning layer owned. Production and ongoing updates route through Studio and Mkt Ops. Full web ownership is a separate role. - Cross-sell narrative defined and live. Clear, tested story for how Addi customers move across BNPL, CF, and Marketplace. Each BU's has a playbook for cross-sell messaging into and out of their product. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Proven experience in product marketing and track record of successfully launching and scaling new products or features. - 5+ years of experience in product marketing, with at least 2-3 years within a high-growth B2C fintech, with a deep understanding of the consumer financial services landscape and competitive dynamics.

goldenventures-waabi:lever:ca67aa9c-d647.description: Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. riverparkvc-via-2-2fb20cbb-5525-40ba-98d.description: Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally. As a City Operations Manager at Via, you will lead the day-to-day operations of two on-demand mobility services in the Dingolfing-Landau and Mühldorf districts. You’ll ensure passengers are reliably transported while driving continuous improvements and operational excellence. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of rural mobility, work closely with drivers and local teams, and make a tangible impact on communities that rely on efficient, reliable public transport. This role is also referred to internally as "Field Manager". What you’ll do: Be the heart of operations for our public transport services - “LanDi” in Dingolfing and the “Rufbus” in Mühldorf - serving as the primary point of contact and operational leader for our drivers. Take full ownership of day-to-day service delivery, ensuring passengers are reliably transported while closely monitoring key performance metrics and operational outcomes. Lead and develop your team by managing onboarding, mentoring drivers, and ensuring efficient shift planning that keeps services running smoothly. Partner closely with Via’s central operations teams to identify opportunities to improve service quality and implement process optimization initiatives. Bring your ideas and operational expertise to continuously enhance the rider and driver experience, helping make our mobility services in the region better every single day. Who you are: Proven experience leading operational teams, ideally in environments with shift-based staff or frontline operations. Comfortable being on-site regularly (at least 3 days per week) to work closely with drivers and support day-to-day operations. Strong interpersonal skills and a calm, solutions-oriented mindset when navigating operational challenges with drivers or external partners. A data-driven approach to problem solving, using performance metrics to guide decisions and improve outcomes. Motivated by fast-paced environments and excited to implement ideas that improve processes and service quality. German language skills at C1 level or higher and English at B2 level or higher. Valid Class B driver’s license. Compensation and Benefits: Becoming part of a company that was awarded for its commitment to social good. Salary Range: between €40,000 and €55,000 per year. Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Urban Sports Club membership. Company pension scheme (bAV) with a 20% employer contribution. 30 vacation days a year. There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride? Via is an equal opportunity employer. #LI-RB1
